#define INIT(subtype)                                                         \
  do {                                                                        \
    if (req == NULL)                                                          \
      return UV_EINVAL;                                                       \
    uv__fs_req_init(loop, req, subtype, cb);                                  \
  }                                                                           \
  while (0)

#define POST                                                                  \
  do {                                                                        \
    if (cb != NULL) {                                                         \
      uv__req_register(loop);                                                 \
      uv__work_submit(loop,                                                   \
                      &req->work_req,                                         \
                      UV__WORK_FAST_IO,                                       \
                      uv__fs_work,                                            \
                      uv__fs_done);                                           \
      return 0;                                                               \
    } else {                                                                  \
      uv__fs_work(&req->work_req);                                            \
      return req->result;                                                     \
    }                                                                         \
  }                                                                           \
  while (0)

#define INIT(subtype)                                                         \
  do {                                                                        \
    if (req == NULL)                                                          \
      return UV_EINVAL;                                                       \
    UV_REQ_INIT(req, UV_FS);                                                  \
    req->fs_type = UV_FS_ ## subtype;                                         \
    req->result = 0;                                                          \
    req->ptr = NULL;                                                          \
    req->loop = loop;                                                         \
    req->path = NULL;                                                         \
    req->new_path = NULL;                                                     \
    req->bufs = NULL;                                                         \
    req->cb = cb;                                                             \
  }                                                                           \
  while (0)
